critical_code_review_comments: WaCampaignPage.jsx:55 — `discount_pct: TEMPLATES[tpl].offer_type === 'discount' || tpl === 'festive' ? discount : null` sends discount_pct for BOTH 'festive' and 'discount' offer types, but backend prompt only uses discount_pct on 'discount' branch (line 182). Not a bug, just harmless overshoot — the festive branch ignores it. Minor: consider aligning UI/backend so discount is only sent for offer_type==='discount'.
WaCampaignPage.jsx:76 — uses window.confirm() blocking browser dialog before queuing. Consider replacing with the existing askConfirm() component to match the rest of the app's design language.

WaCampaignPage.jsx:82 — `new Date(schedAt).toISOString()` when schedAt is a datetime-local string (no timezone) creates ambiguity across DST/timezones. Better: send the raw local string and let backend parse in the tenant's timezone; or explicitly show the user their IST equivalent.

whatsapp_link.py:_audience_ids — 'all' audience is capped at .to_list(500), silently truncating tenants with >500 customers. UI shows counts.all min-clipped at 500 too. If growth expected, revisit as a paginated batch job.

whatsapp_link.py:CampaignIn — scheduled_at is Optional[str] with max_length=40. Consider `Optional[datetime]` with proper validator so bad values fail at 422 before hitting the ids check (currently returns 400 on empty ids first, hiding the 'Bad schedule time' 400 in that combo).
